title: Motorist spots fawn beside busy Singapore expressway, alerts rescuers
summary_full: A motorist rescued a severely dehydrated sambar deer found beside Singapore's Bukit Timah Expressway on November 8. NParks took it to the Mandai Wildlife Centre, where veterinarians provided treatment and monitored it overnight. After its condition improved, the fawn was released near the spot where it was found on November 9.
